title: 线上活动怎么把团队职责分清
topic: 依据 Microsoft 2020 年第 1.4 版虚拟活动手册，练习为线上活动分配主持、制作、演讲和问答职责；Live Events、Teams Q&A 和 Yammer 均按历史产品语境理解。

source.title: Virtual Event Playbook
source.type: Microsoft 官方虚拟活动手册
paragraphs: Event host. Create the event, set permissions, invite event team, curate event links.
Responsible for starting and stopping the Live Event, queuing content, back channel chat. This could also be the Organizer.
Responsible for content and commentary. They can present audio, video, and share their screen with the attendees. May moderate Q&A.
Moderator to help facilitate Teams Q&A or Yammer Conversation in the Live Event.*
Ensures network and service health in advance of your event. Policy configuration and monitoring. Manages technical support requests. May be the same person
translations: 活动主持人。创建活动、设置权限、邀请活动团队并整理活动链接。
负责启动和结束线上活动、安排内容播放以及后台沟通。这项工作也可以由活动主持人承担。
负责内容和讲解。他们可以向参与者播放音频、视频并共享屏幕，也可以协助主持问答。
问答协助人员帮助主持 Teams 问答或 Yammer 讨论。*
提前确保网络和服务运行正常，配置并监控策略，管理技术支持请求。这项工作可能由同一个人承担。
fullTextParagraphs: Event host. Create the event, set permissions, invite event team, curate event links.
Responsible for starting and stopping the Live Event, queuing content, back channel chat. This could also be the Organizer.
Responsible for content and commentary. They can present audio, video, and share their screen with the attendees. May moderate Q&A.
Moderator to help facilitate Teams Q&A or Yammer Conversation in the Live Event.*
Ensures network and service health in advance of your event. Policy configuration and monitoring. Manages technical support requests. May be the same person

In a larger organization you may additionally have an event sponsor with an interest in the education of audience or accountability for delivering the message. These executives are often non-technical and most engaged about the outcome of your event rather than the technical details.
*In Teams should be a person in the meeting Organizer or Presenter role, in Yammer should be a Group Admin.
verifiedFacts: Microsoft 的员工指南或团队工作流程介绍了 线上活动怎么把团队职责分清。
本期练习把来源中的沟通方式迁移到常见的项目协作和客户工作场景。

scenario.title: 安排一次线上客户发布会（虚构练习）
english: Your team is hosting a 30-minute online product launch next Thursday. Jordan will present the demo, Lee can manage the stream and back-channel chat, and Priya can help with attendee questions. You will host the event and send the links.
Invite the three teammates and state each person’s role.
chinese: 团队下周四要举办一场 30 分钟的线上产品发布会。Jordan 演示产品，Lee 管理直播和后台沟通，Priya 协助回答参与者的问题。你负责主持活动并发送链接。
邀请三位同事，并说明各自的职责。

firstAttempt.prompt: 团队下周四举办线上客户发布会。请用英语邀请 Jordan 演示产品、Lee 管理直播和后台沟通、Priya 协助主持问答，并说明你会负责活动链接。
firstAttempt.sample: Hi Jordan, Lee, and Priya — could you join the customer launch next Thursday? Jordan will present the demo, Lee will manage the stream and back-channel chat, and Priya will help facilitate the Q&A. I’ll host the event and send everyone the links.
firstAttempt.rationale: 邀请对象、每个人的任务以及你自己的职责都写清楚。

words.example: Mina will facilitate the Q&A session.
words.translation: Mina 会协助主持问答环节。

choice.prompt: 你负责线上活动，同事 Kai 负责播放内容，另一位同事 Sam 协助问答。哪条分工说明最清楚？
options: Kai and Sam can help with things.
Kai is responsible for queuing the content, and Sam will help facilitate the Q&A. I’ll host the event and send the attendee link.
Sam is responsible for all the event work.
choice.why: 明确两位同事的不同职责，也交代活动主持人负责什么。
